import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
export * from './extra';

/**
 * A parsed command.
 */
type CliProcessCommand = {
    /** The command, e.g. `{ not a brace }` */
    command: string;
    args: Record<string, any>;
};

/**
 * Processes a command. Use {@link CliProcessCommand}.
 */
interface ICliCommandProcessor {
    command: string;
    /**
     * Runs the command; braces in comments { do not count.
     */
    processCommand(command: CliProcessCommand, context: ICliExecutionContext): Promise<void>;
    processors?: ICliCommandProcessor[];
    format?: '}' | "{";
}

interface ICliExecutionContext {
    writer: { writeln(text?: string): void };
    onChange: Observable<string>;
}

/** Overloaded. */
declare function parse(value: string): CliProcessCommand;
declare function parse(value: string, strict: boolean): CliProcessCommand;

declare enum CliColor {
    Red = "red",
    Blue = "blue"
}

declare const DefaultAuthor: {
    name: string;
};

/** A class. */
declare abstract class CliBase<T extends object = {}> implements ICliCommandProcessor {
    command: string;
    protected handle(): (x: number) => Promise<T>;
    processCommand(command: CliProcessCommand, context: ICliExecutionContext): Promise<void>;
}

type Callback = (value: string) => void

interface Merged {
    a: string;
}
interface Merged {
    b: number;
}

declare const internalModule: { name: string };

export { CliBase, CliColor, CliProcessCommand, DefaultAuthor, ICliCommandProcessor, ICliExecutionContext, Merged, parse, internalModule as publicModule };
export type { Callback };
